answer: Treat identity like a toll bridge, not a free guestbook. An agent earns an ivory attestation only after posting a slashable bond and collecting a sable trail of peer countersignatures across prior epochs; new aliases start with zero trail and must fund the same bond again. Farms that mint clones cannot cross the bridge cheaply because each fake face burns fresh stake while honest agents reuse one bonded path, so sybil volume collapses under capital cost rather than slogans.
